parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The input parameters of the rule
parameters.name: input_parameters

parameters.help_en:
The owner of the rule. Valid values:

CUSTOM_FC: user-defined function.

ALIYUN: managed rule
parameters.help_zh:
规则来源的归属。取值：
CUSTOM_FC：用户自定义函数。
ALIYUN：托管规则
parameters.name: source_owner

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the rule.

If the rule is a managed rule, the value of this parameter is the identifier of the managed rule.

If the rule is a user-defined function, the value of this parameter is the Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the function
parameters.help_zh:
规则标识。

如果规则使用了托管规则，则该参数为规则标识。

如果规则使用了自定义函数，则该参数为函数ARN
parameters.name: source_identifier

parameters.help_en:
The trigger type of the rule. Valid values:

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification: The rule is triggered by configuration changes.

ScheduledNotification: The rule is triggered periodically
parameters.help_zh:
规则的触发机制。取值：
ConfigurationItemChangeNotification：配置变更。
ScheduledNotification：周期执行
parameters.name: source_detail_message_type

parameters.help_en:
The frequency at which the rule is executed. Valid values:

One_Hour: 1 hour.

Three_Hours: 3 hours.

Six_Hours: 6 hours.

Twelve_Hours: 12 hours.

TwentyFour_Hours: 24 hours
parameters.help_zh:
规则执行周期。取值：
One_Hour：1小时。
Three_Hours：3小时。
Six_Hours：6小时。
Twelve_Hours：12小时。
TwentyFour_Hours：24小时
parameters.name: source_maximum_execution_frequency

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource to be evaluated.

If you leave this parameter empty, the rule evaluates all resources of the resource types specified by the ScopeComplianceResourceTypes parameter.

If you specify this parameter, the rule evaluates only the specified resource
parameters.help_zh:
待评估资源ID。

如果为空，则该规则评估ScopeComplianceResourceTypes指定的所有资源类型。

如果不为空，则该规则评估指定的资源
parameters.name: scope_compliance_resource_id

parameters.help_en: The types of the resources to be evaluated
parameters.help_zh: 待评估的资源类型列表
parameters.name: scope_compliance_resource_types

parameters.help_en:
The risk level. Valid values:

1: high risk.

2: medium risk.

3: low risk
parameters.help_zh:
风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en: A client token. It is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token
